note: binary outcome, not money — this tests the POLICY claim, not an effect size
rule: Targeting is claimable only if the paired bootstrap interval on (targeted minus matched-volume random) excludes zero AND all three estimators agree on the sign. Sign agreement alone was Tier 1b's rule and proved too weak; the bar is raised here before seeing any result.
verdict: CLAIMABLE: targeting beats matched-volume random targeting on real randomised data. The paired interval excludes zero and all three estimators agree on the sign. B1's central claim is no longer simulator-only.
